court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Mayra Alias Vaishnvi Vilas Shirshikar ... vs State Of Up And Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mayra Alias Vaishnvi Vilas Shirshikar And Another (husband, wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and Others (wife's parents, husband's family)

facts_of_case: Multiple women filed writ petitions against their husbands and in-laws for maintenance and other reliefs.

legal_principles.principle: The right to convert another person to one's own religion is not granted by Article 25(1), but only the freedom to transmit or spread one's religion by an exposition of its tenets.
legal_principles.held: What the article (25) grants is not the right to convert another person to one's own religion, but to transmit or spread one's religion by an exposition of its tenets.
cited_cases: Rev. Stainislaus vs. State of Madhya Pradesh

legal_principles.principle: One has a right to propagate one's religion, but not to convert another person.
legal_principles.held: The Court was of the view that one has a right to propagate but not to propagate in order to convert another.

legal_principles.principle: Religious conversions without a bona fide belief and for the sole purpose of deriving some legal benefit are illegal.
legal_principles.held: The Supreme Court held that religious conversion without a bona fide belief and for the sole purpose of deriving some legal benefit are illegal.
cited_cases: Lily Thomas vs. Union of India
Sarla Mudgal vs. Union of India

outcome.final_order: The court granted the relief of maintenance to the petitioners.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in property division disputes
